text:
jamie: Quick post-launch sync — v2 shipped. We have 2 customer blockers (generation artifacts on long context, CSV export mismatch) + a pile of enhancement asks from pilots. Need to pick sprint cut. My draft: hotpatch the customer issues, pick ONE retention-focused enhancement if <=1 dev-day, move rest to backlog + tag. Thoughts?

nidhi: +1 to hotpatch. Can you list the blocking customer flows so eng & CS can triage impact?

frank: CS summary: (1) long-context artifact where last 200 tokens repeat for customer Q (blocks their review flow). (2) embeddings export misaligns when rows have empty tags (breaks downstream join). Both are blocking.

jamie: Thanks. My risk tolerance is low on customer-facing bugs — ship patch. For enhancements, I'm wary of anything touching routing or serialization in this sprint.

frank: We also got asks for: inline prompt hints (UX), per-route quota UI, and export presets. Inline hint seems cheap and likely improves retention; per-route quota touches console & billing (bigger).

nidhi: Agree. Gate any enhancement that touches model routing or the runtime unless it’s a trivial flag change. Also require that any enhancement that may add >25ms p99 needs product+eng lead sign-off.

jamie: Plan A (fast): Hotpatch serializer fix + add a prompt-length safety check and a logging signal for artifacts, canary 5% -> monitor 1h -> roll. UX quickwin: inline prompt hint in composer if design copy ready in 1d. Plan B (if root cause spans runtime): only serializer + mitigation + rollback flag.

frank: I can reproduce both bugs. Serializer fix is ~3–4h. Artifact is tied to attention cache boundary; looks like a corner-case when context crosses a checkpoint. I can try a mitigation that adds a boundary-safe flush. Est: 1d.

ops-bot: alert: gen_artifact_rate increased to 0.03 at 10:12 UTC. Incident INC-1999 created.

lina: ops question: can we do a targeted canary by model-shard so we don't touch global traffic?

ops-bot: canary-request accepted: shard-4 5% -> scheduled in 10m. Will post health updates here.

nidhi: Good. Also add a CI regression test: tests/generation/test_artifact_edgecases.py. Make it part of the gate for releases.

frank: Working on serializer PR now (branch fix/export-headers). Will include small unit test. For artifacts, I'll implement boundary-safe flush behind a feature flag so we can canary it.

jamie: Decision log: Hotpatch = approve (serializer + artifact mitigation behind flag). Quick UX = approve if <=1 dev-day (owner: lina). All other asks -> backlog with tags [customer-request, post-launch]. Add gating rule: defer any enhancement that increases p99 >25ms without eng lead approval.

lina: I'll own the inline prompt hint. Will post mock + copy by EOD. Estimate 0.5d.

ops-bot: canary started -> 3/5 hosts healthy. Metrics: gen_latency +2ms, artifact_rate -> 0.001. No new errors.

frank: PRs: serializer merged, artifact mitigation drafted. CI tests passing locally. Planning to enable flag on canary only.

nidhi: Add a short comms template for CS: one-sentence explanation, ETA, workaround (split prompts into chunks), and promise to follow up. Frank, can you add technical blurb we can paste?

frank: Will add blurb in the PR description.

jamie: Roll strategy: 5% canary -> 1h stable -> 50% -> 100%. If any increase in artifact_rate or latency >10ms, abort and rollback. Ops to run the rollout and post status.

ops-bot: canary stable at 45m. Scheduling 50% rollout. No regressions observed.

lina: mock + copy pushed to #design review. small tweak requested, but still within estimate.

frank: After 2h stable window we'll roll to 100%. Also scheduling a 30-min retro tomorrow to discuss why artifact tests missed this case and add long-context cases to perf/regression suite.

jamie: OK thanks. I'll update the roadmap board: v2.0.1 = hotpatch; v2.1 = inline hint + backlog grooming session next Tue. CS update: frank to draft, lina to add user-facing copy. Good job team :rocket:
